name: Aske
title: Company Escort-man
examine: Low Hall born, red sash, a crew of four and a banner flying under a lamp that is not theirs. Paid for the road. Not for under it.
lines: We are paid for the road. Not for under it. The hole is the road's problem and the road can take it up with the diggers.
Four of us and a lamp that is not ours. When something comes out of the wood at night it finds us first. That is the contract and it is not a complaint.
Roald walked past a lamp at dusk and the lamp said nothing that counted. I will pay for eleven gnolls. I do not need to know their names.
